title: Tsung Siao Woo Ts

page_data.en:

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
832
17/5/16.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
May 16th 1916.

Sir,
A robber band visited Quinsan a few days ago and looted that City. The local magistrate has reported the matter to General Yang and has requested the latter to send troops to preserve peace in the district.
The rebel force on the Tahu lake consists of about six hundred men. It is reported that they are armed with machine guns, rifles and revolvers. At present two of their officers named Tsung Siao Woo Ts 曾小虎子 and Tsong Paung Ts 鐘胖 are in Shanghai conferring with local rebel leaders.
General Yang received a telegram yesterday requesting him to be very economical and dismiss all supernumeries whose services are not absolutely indispensable.

Your Obedient Servant,
mmim muntine
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

16/5.

Entered on M.S. May 16.
Copy sent to I.V.C.

编号
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）
832
16/5/16.
上海工部局。
1916年5月16日。

先生：
数日前，一伙匪帮窜至昆山，对该城进行了抢劫。当地知县已将此事报告给杨将军，并请求后者派兵维持该地区治安。
太湖地区的叛军约有六百人。据报，他们装备有机枪、步枪和左轮手枪。目前，该部两名军官曾小虎子 (Tsung Siao Woo Ts) 和钟胖 (Tsong Paung Ts) 正在上海与当地叛军首领进行磋商。
杨将军昨日收到电报，要求他务必厉行节约，裁撤所有非绝对必要的冗员。

您顺从的仆人，
mmim muntine
总探长。

警察总监上尉。

16/5.

于5月16日录入警务处档案 (M.S.)。
副本已送交义勇队指挥官 (I.V.C.)。
